verdict.rationale: Payment platforms can plausibly offer configurable automations such as recurring billing, retry rules or payout schedules, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack shows no versioning, review or rollback of any automation or configuration. Recurring Pix, smart retry logic and scheduled payouts are adjacent payment features. They are not version control or rollback for user-defined automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
